questions.stemHtml: A 27-year-old IT professional has presented to you with intense watering, redness, and foreign body sensation in the eye for the past 2 months. He took out his contact lens and applied eye lubricants to help alleviate his ailment, but it didn't provide any relief. What is the most probable diagnosis?
